name: Tether USD
description: Tether USD (USDT) is a BEP20 token on BNB Smart Chain at 0x9C63A31Be81Fd286C4Eb54C63D5bd251ce5f28d2, 6 decimals, 50,000,000 supply. Its $1 target is held by a 1:1 USDT pool on PancakeSwap V2 — liquidity-enforced, not contract-enforced. It exposes the Tether-compatible surface, so wallets and routers treat it like any USDT contract.
